final:
def accepted(cap: int, xs: list[int]) -> int uses nondet:
    """Send each element of xs into a new Channel[int] of capacity cap with try_send, stopping at the first full channel. Returns how many sends were accepted."""
    pre cap >= 0
    post out >= 0
    post out <= xs.len()
    post out <= cap
    tx, rx = Channel[int](cap)
    n = 0
    for x in xs:
        tx.try_send(x) else return n
        n += 1
    return n
